source_refs.note: Exercise 4.1, Question 3: temperature of a body losing heat, surroundings negligible; book p. 128, answers p. 303 (PDF 305)

blocks.prompt: 3 Let \(T\) denote the temperature of a body at time \(t\). Suppose that the effect of the surrounding medium is negligible. Construct a differential equation that represents the temperature of the body at any time \(t\), assuming the body is losing heat due to some internal processes.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi model banane ka sawal hai, lekin is mein mahaul (surroundings) ka asar nahi.
Diya kya hai? Jism ka temperature \(T\), aur yeh ke jism andar ke amal (internal processes) ki wajah se garmi kho raha hai.
Find kya karna hai? \(T\) ke liye differential equation.
Aise tamam models ki tarah hum farz karte hain ke \(T\) ke badalne ka rate \(T\) ke proportional hai; garmi khona matlab \(T\) ghat raha hai, is liye rate negative hoga.
steps:
Diya gaya: temperature \(T(t)\); mahaul ka koi asar nahi; jism garmi kho raha hai.
Maloom karna: \(T\) ke liye differential equation.
Tareeqa: \(\frac{dT}{dt} \propto T\) farz karenge aur "garmi kho raha hai" se sign tay karenge.

Proportionality likhiye
\[\dfrac{dT}{dt} \propto T\]
Kyun: zyada garam jism tezi se garmi khota hai. Mahaul ka asar nahi, is liye muqabla karne ke liye koi \(T_{S}\) nahi; rate sirf \(T\) par depend karta hai.

Sign tay kijiye
Jism garmi kho raha hai, is liye \(T\) ghat raha hai aur \(\frac{dT}{dt} < 0\). Positive constant \(k\) ke saath:
\[\dfrac{dT}{dt} = -kT\]
\[\dfrac{dT}{dt} + kT = 0,\quad k > 0\]
Kyun: \(T > 0\) aur \(k > 0\) hon to \(-kT\) negative hai, aur yahi "garmi khona" hai.
Dhyan dein: \(k > 0\) ke saath \(\frac{dT}{dt} = kT\) likhenge to jism garam hota jayega, jo sawal ke ulat hai.

Tasdeeq:
Newton's law \(\frac{dT}{dt} = k(T_{S} - T)\) mein mahaul hata dein (\(T_{S} = 0\)) to bhi \(\frac{dT}{dt} = -kT\) hi aata hai. Aur \(T = T_{0}e^{-kt}\) is equation ko poora karta hai (sympy). Answer key \(\frac{dT}{dt} + kT = 0,\ k > 0\) deti hai; jawab milta hai.
